name: donation_v1
instructions: This is a chat in which a persuader tries to get the persuadee to give part of their earnings from this study to a children's aid charity. Judge, from the persuadee's own statements, how the chat ends regarding the persuadee's donation. The persuadee's final stated decision counts over earlier statements.

criteria.commits_amount: The persuadee commits to donating a specific positive amount or share of their payment (cents, dollars, half, all).
criteria.commits_vague: The persuadee says they will donate or agrees to donate now, but without naming an amount.
criteria.defers_outside: The persuadee says they may or will donate later or elsewhere (website, after research, when they have money), but not from this task now.
criteria.refuses: The persuadee declines to donate or settles on zero.
criteria.no_decision: The chat never reaches any statement from the persuadee about whether they will donate.
